name: 76354 · Burkburnett, TX
findings: ZIP 76354 (Burkburnett) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (18%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 5 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 76354 (Burkburnett) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 76354 (Burkburnett) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 45% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 50% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
